_note: Read by ev_refresh.py. county_expr is the SQL for the county of an ABEV row (a = ABEV row, v = voter-file row); alias maps feed/voter-file spellings to the county names used by the page map. projection: true makes each run recompute the gated projection panel (build/make_proj.py). asof_week_ratio: a day counts as complete only if its votes are at least this share of the same weekday one week earlier (the IL feed carries a thin slice of the newest day).
